notes.title: Patch Notes v0.2.6
notes.content:
- Improvements -

1. Reduced interference between buttons and related menus when clicking with the mouse.

2. Elemental Shard Improvements

   - The effects of elemental shards have been changed.
   - The light size of elemental shards has been reduced.

   We have improved areas where optimization and visibility were lacking.

3. The light size of crystal shards has been reduced.

4. Spawn positions of stationary enemies have been adjusted.

   - We determined that having to search for non-moving enemies on a dark and unexpectedly large map was unnecessarily unpleasant.
   - These enemies will now spawn closer to the center.

5. The "Conductor" status effect of the 'Shadow' enemy has been adjusted.

6. Ice Element Adjustment

   - The number of icicles generated by throwing attacks has been reduced.
   - Icicles generated by throwing attacks will now be more concentrated around the impact location.


- Bug Fixes -

1. Issue where no description appeared when selecting a throwable weapon.

2. Issue where some boss patterns produced excessively loud sound effects.

3. Issue where the accessory "Piercing Tracker" produced abnormal effects.

notes.title: patch note v 0.2.5
notes.content:
v 0.2.5

– Improvements –

- Difficulty Adjustments
	The number of enemies that can exist in a single room in The Nameless Cave (Stage 1) has been reduced by approximately 25%.
	Rats now have a longer wind-up time before attacking.
	Rats now have increased delay after attacking.
	Rats now have a longer cooldown between attacks.
	Rats' movement speed has been reduced by 10%.

These changes were made carefully. Due to enemy patterns and player hit-stun, even the “Easy” difficulty could feel unforgiving.
We expect these changes will make the first stage feel more in line with the intended difficulty.


- Scroll speed adjustments
	Fixed areas where the scroll speed was excessively fast.

- Improved throwable weapon descriptions
	When selecting a throwable weapon, detailed item information now appears on the right side of the UI.


– Bug Fixes –
	Fixed an issue where special weapon descriptions were incorrectly displayed.
	Fixed a bug that prevented players from immediately assigning the first selected proficiency skill.

notes.title: Demo Update Notice
notes.content:
The demo had been on hold due to optimization issues, but since the release is currently blocked, I’ve updated it with some improvements from the Early Access version.

It's not exactly new content, but you can now unlock a weapon that wasn’t available in the original demo by defeating the boss twice.
Why not give it a try while you wait? (It’s really going to be tough...)
Thanks!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.22V
notes.content:
Hello! We've made some QoL updates for the demo and adjusted weapon balance.

1. Menu Popup Improvements
- In popup menus (except pause menu), pressing interaction, inventory, or map keys will now directly close the window without entering the interaction tab.

2. Weapon Rebalancing
- Slightly increased base accuracy for all firearms.
- Reduced recoil for assault rifles.
- Assault rifles now have lower damage and stagger effect but increased fire rate.
- Maximum ammo capacity for assault rifles increased by 5 rounds.

The firearms had excessive recoil, and assault rifles were nearly impossible to use effectively in combat with burst fire without attachments due to severe recoil. These adjustments were made to make assault rifles perform more true to their intended role.

3. UI Changes
- Ammo capacity is now displayed with a slider.

Thank you.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.20V
notes.content:
Hello!
Risk the Dark has been updated.
I used to make small updates gradually, but I realized I could leave notices like this.
From now on, I'll keep you updated here.
Update Details:

1.Elemental Effect Improvements
 - Wind and Dark elemental effects have been improved.
 - Projectiles with Wind and Dark effects now deal area damage.
 - Sound effects for elemental effects have been changed.


2. Dagger Buff
 - The dagger's strong attack multiplier has been increased to 2.5x.


Since it felt like an inferior version of the bat in every aspect, we added the characteristic of having stronger counterattacks.

3. Menu Control Improvements
 - Fixed issues where unnecessary actions were required to press buttons in certain locations.

4. Sound Improvements

 - Fixed an issue where BGM volume would unintentionally decrease when adjusting it in the options.
 - Balanced the sound effects between different melee weapons in the game.

I will continue to bring you new updates.
Thank you.
